text:
paul: FYI set a prep call tomorrow 9:30am PT with vendor PMs + SI leads. Goal: rehearse joint announcement choreography for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi and validate marketplace gating. Need final decisions on embargo exceptions and fallback routing.

carla: Marketplace ops here  prefer to publish hidden SKUs for SI onboarding. Gate public flip on `signed_driver_checksum` + `driver_signoff` + `quote_review_ok`. Request stable image tag naming convention: `vendor-model-YYYYMMDD-canary`.

jin: Infra: we'll produce nightly canaries and signed checksums. Vendors gave ranges: Nvidia ~end-Mar, AMD MI300 mid-Apr, Gaudi early-Apr. Still volatile. CI can run nightly smoke and post `ci_smoke: pass|fail`.

rafa: SI asks: can we get 2 dry-run cycles with the same image tag? Lab slots for Gaudi are tight. Also need perf targets (p95, throughput).

paul: Proposal for announce cadence to avoid press collisions:
- Phase 0: Partner preview + SI hidden listings (H100, Gaudi)
- Phase 1: Marketplace publish (MI300, B200) once `driver_signoff`
- Phase 2: Public blog + press (H200) after quote review window

carla: We'll allow `prelist_visibility: hidden` and a `prelist_access: partner,si` ACL. Public flip requires `signed_driver_checksum` uploaded to artifacts bucket.

jin: Adding routing policy snippet for ops to test in staging:
```
routing_policy:
  primary: H200
  fallback: [H100,B200]
  ttl_days: 14
```
We'll wire this into Runtime so it can rotate traffic if H200 slips.

rafa: I'll draft the SI smoke matrix (basic infer, batching, KV cache restore, restart/resume). Need signups by EOD Friday for Apr lab windows.

paul: Marketing asks for 72h quote review as default (vendors requested 48h; legal wants 72h). We'll use 72h unless vendor explicitly signs 48h. Add `quote_review_window` to runbook.

carla: Note: marketplace pricing metadata must include `dedicated_min_commit_days` for Dedicated SKU offers. Who owns pricing input? @partner-bot any finance contact list?

partner-bot: Finance liaison: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partners/pages/Finance+liaisons (shared) :link: 

jin: Will publish canary URLs and CI badges to the shared doc. I'll tag artifacts with `canary_ok` when smoke passes and `driver_signoff` when QA approves.

rafa: Also propose a fallback public statement template if H200 slips >14 days, offering SI assistance and prioritized patches. I'll draft and share.

paul: Action owners recap:
- Jin: nightly canaries + signed checksums + CI badges
- Carla: marketplace gating + prelist ACLs + pricing metadata
- Rafa: SI signup sheet + smoke test matrix + fallback statement
- Paul: embargo runbook + vendor opt-in doc

partner-bot: Calendar invite created: "HW announcement rehearsal" Tomorrow 09:30 PT  https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1743217777-rehearsal :white_check_mark: 

carla: One edge-case: Nvidia asked for a 48h embargo review on quotes for co-marketing. We'll flag exceptions in the opt-in doc.

jin: Small ops note: pls avoid public flips on Thursdays if possible (industry press heavy). Recommend Tue/Wed publish cadence.

paul: Good catches. If any vendor slips or legal exceptions come up, bump this thread and we'll re-run the cadence. :thumbsup:
